abilities.effect: If the characters are Traveling, one of them (determined randomly) steps in a trap. If the characters are Reconnoitering, 1d4 of them (determined randomly) step in a trap. When a creature steps in a trap, the trap makes a bear trap Strike against the creature.
abilities.name: Clamp Shut
abilities.trigger: Anyone Travels or Reconnoiters this hex

hazard.description: Several dozen spike snares are littered across this hex.
hazard.disable: DC 17 Survival (made as an individual hexploration activity) to locate and disarm all the traps by hand.
hazard.name: Breeg's Traps
hazard.reset: There are enough traps in this hex that this hazard can be triggered up to 5 times before all the traps are used up.

traits.name: Mechanical
traits.text: A hazard with this trait is a constructed physical object.

traits.name: Trap
traits.text: A hazard constructed to hinder interlopers.
